alternate_mechanisms.name: mercy_and_blessing_rejected_before_fire
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Under the basmala, the denied best promise includes mercy, blessing, and gracious guidance; warning makes that alternative visible before repeated denial converts the announced fire from communication into suffered punishment.

alternate_mechanisms.name: obligation_liability_and_deserved_judgment
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Warning establishes obligation; denial fails the charge; debtor and compensation images model unresolved liability; and the final superlative rank expresses deserved judgment. Debt, wound, and compensation are analogies rather than surface events.

alternate_mechanisms.name: guidance_as_gift_beyond_exchange
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Guidance and the ultimate good arrive in the semantic field of gracious gift, while property remains transferable but unable to purchase, replace, or negotiate away the final collapse.

alternate_mechanisms.name: warning_signal_flight_and_entrapment
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Guidance displays fire as a distant signal and beacon; aversion flees that signal, but repeated turning away becomes instability and entrapment until the same fire is encountered.

alternate_mechanisms.name: wealth_cannot_shelter_or_carry_at_death
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Settlement and property promise worldly shelter, yet neither suffices at ruin; the rare bier/support image marks the difference between carrying a fallen person and rescuing him from the final encounter.

alternate_mechanisms.name: assigned_priority_and_exclusive_rank
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Facilitation culminates in an assigned outcome whose exclusive recipient has acquired the fitting evaluated state and rank through denial and aversion; sequence and priority explain the force of 'none but the most wretched.'

alternate_mechanisms.name: visible_disclosure_of_first_and_later
alternate_mechanisms.summary: Within the first life, guidance and warning give the later realm a visible outline through the announced beacon-fire; divine ownership of both realms therefore includes disclosure of their continuity.

alternate_mechanisms.name: wealth_cannot_bargain_with_outcome
alternate_mechanisms.summary: False rhetoric, obstruction, and commercial transfer can manage worldly relations but cannot bargain with divine guidance or make wealth sufficient once the course reaches ruin and its attained outcome.
